info.title: &bookme present API
info.description: API endpoints for creating PowerPoint decks from templates, and for configuring tag mappings.

get.summary:
Downloads the content behind contentRef as a .pptx attachment. Auth-gated
(TenancyMiddleware rejects unauthenticated callers → 401) and org-scoped: a contentRef belonging
to another organization is denied by contentStore isolation and surfaced as 404 (no existence
leak).

delete.summary:
Deletes a standalone (CRM-free) saved deck: crypto-erases the durable
contentStore object behind contentRef AND removes its
BookmePresent.Database.Models.SavedPresentation row. Org-scoped: the erase and the row lookup both
use the caller's `GetBlobTenantId()` — the SAME org the deck was saved under — so a
contentRef owned by another bank is neither erased nor removed and surfaces as 404 (no existence
leak). Idempotent at the contentStore layer. Only the standalone deck store is touched; the frozen
CRM ContentVersion delete path is untouched.

post.summary:
Standalone (CRM-free) analogue of `Slides/Generate`. Renders the deck with
the SAME render core, stages it into contentStore with Durable retention under the SAME org the
render/download legs use for this tenant (blobTenantId), persists a bank-scoped
BookmePresent.Database.Models.SavedPresentation row, and returns the stable `contentRef`. Reopen the deck via
`GET /content/{contentRef}`. The frozen Slides/Generate path is left untouched.

get.summary: Get every tag mapping for the current bank, one entry per mapping.

post.summary: Create a tag mapping. An empty field is valid and means the tag is not mapped yet.

get.summary: Get every tag available for mapping, for the tag picker.

put.summary: Update the tag mapping identified by id — the mapping id, not the tag id.

delete.summary: Delete the tag mapping identified by id. Leaves the tag itself alone.

post.summary:
Rebuilds this bank's Present entity pattern from its stored mappings, and reports what the
compile produced.
            
Set dropUndescribable only when an object the pattern reads is known to be
gone from the CRM. A compile otherwise refuses in that case, because the CRM answers the same
way when it is merely unwell, and dropping the tags of a live object blanks them on every
deck. The response names every tag that was dropped.

get.summary: Get all templates for the current bank, optionally filtered by labels.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Optional list of label names to filter by. Only templates that have all specified labels will be returned.

get.summary: Get a single template by ID with full details including sections and slides.

patch.summary: Update the labels on a template.

requestBody.description: The labels to set on the template

get.summary:
Get all available templates.
When labels are provided, only templates matching ALL specified labels are returned.
Templates are enriched with their labels when organizationId is available.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Optional list of label names to filter by. Only templates that have all specified labels will be returned.

post.summary:
Creates a template in blob storage from a file input.
This assumes that the files Isn't already created in CRM, so this will also upload and create entities in CRM.
This endpoint is the entry point used by the MGMT UI to upload templates

Uploads a template to blob storage, where the content already exists in CRM
This endpoint is the entry point used by the salesforce package

Validates a template and returns translatable results with status codes and interpolation parameters.
Use this endpoint when you need to display validation messages in the user's language.

contentId.description:
CRM ContentVersion id. Populated by the Slides/Generate CRM path; null for the standalone
Slides/Save response, which carries BookmePresent.Api.Models.CreatePowerpointResponse.ContentRef instead.

contentRef.description:
Standalone-mode (CRM-free) contentStore reference for the saved deck — the stable fileRef.
Populated by the standalone Slides/Save path; null for the frozen CRM
Slides/Generate response. Additive and nullable.

GetAllTagsResponse.description: An available tag, for the tag picker. Mirrors the crm-integration shape.

name.description: The name of the modifier as used in tag syntax (e.g., "capitalize", "uppercase")

ITagModifier.description:
Interface for tag modifiers that can transform tag values during processing.
Modifiers are applied in sequence and can be chained together.

PresentCompileSummary.description: What a compile produced, for logging and for telling a configurator what was dropped.

PresentSkipKind.description: An BookmePresent.Api.Models.PresentConfig.PresentSkipKind.AliasCollision is filed under one tag but caused by a pair.

PresentSkippedMapping.description: A mapping the compiler could not use. The tag is left out rather than failing the compile.

dateModified.description: Present-only; the crm-integration mirror has no equivalent.

PresentTagDto.description:
A tag together with one of its mappings. Mirrors the crm-integration Tags response so the
management UI has one model for both storage modes: one entry per mapping, so a tag with two
mappings appears twice and a tag with none does not appear at all.

contentRef.description:
Standalone-mode (CRM-free) contentStore reference for the template payload — the stable fileRef.
Null for CRM-mode templates. Additive and nullable.

PresentTemplateDetailsDto.description: Detailed DTO for Template entity (includes sections/slides).

contentRef.description:
Standalone-mode (CRM-free) contentStore reference for the template payload — the stable fileRef.
Null for CRM-mode templates. Additive and nullable.

PresentTemplateDto.description: DTO for Template (excludes sections/slides for lightweight responses).

contentRef.description:
Standalone-mode (CRM-free) contentStore reference for the uploaded template payload — the stable
fileRef. Null for CRM-mode banks, which continue to resolve content through the
frozen Salesforce/CRM path. Additive and nullable so existing CRM responses are unchanged.

name.description: The name of the tag, e.g., "title", "author", "date"

modifiers.description:
List of modifiers to be applied to this tag during processing.
Modifiers are applied in the order they appear in this list.

rawModifiers.description:
Raw modifier strings from the original tag syntax.
Used for validation and debugging purposes.

field.description:
`Entity[field]` segments joined by `.`. Empty or null is valid and means the tag is not
mapped yet; null is accepted because the crm-integration payload allows it.

TagMappingDto.description: Create/update payload for a tag mapping. Mirrors the crm-integration shape.

tags.description:
Names of the tags (placeholders) scoped to this slide, projected from the Slide entity's
Tags navigation. Lets the composer scope which placeholders belong to which slide. Additive
and defaults to empty; serialized as camelCase 'tags'.

UpdateTemplateLabelsInput.description: Input model for updating template labels.

Bearer.description: Put **_ONLY_** your JWT Bearer token on textbox below!
